title: Area 8 · Klarg’s cave

sourceRecords.title: Area 8 · Klarg’s cave
read: Sacks and crates fill the far side of the cave. Smoke from a low fire climbs toward an opening above. Behind the stolen supplies, a hulking figure rises, morningstar in hand, while a wolf bares its teeth.

The stacked goods divide the cavern into patches of cover and narrow sightlines. Firelight catches the raised weapon and the wolf's teeth, while smoke drifts toward the opening overhead. The way you entered remains behind you as you choose how to answer this reception.

brief: Cragmaw area8 cave, looted mundane crates/sacks at SOUTH, most display simple BLUE LION emblem, central smoldering COAL FIRE, WEST floor slopes to narrow chimney opening, broad NORTH opening down natural stone steps toward waterfall. Prepared HISTORICAL encounter: ONE furry bugbear Klarg, ONE mangy wolf Ripper, TWO goblins visible if discovered. No throne, glowing token or opened treasure chest. Klarg was killed in actual play: this is original encounter art, not present occupancy.
